Description: "Remove the card container from TransitionSplashScreen so the locker dial floats on the transparent dark background with no card border, no card shadow, no card gradient — just the dial and text centered on screen."
Instruction: "Replace the card wrapper div and the radial glow div with a transparent container that has no background, border, or shadow."
ReplacementContent: "    <div className=\"text-white text-center select-none mx-4\">\n      {/* Subtle radial glow behind dial */}\n      <div className=\"fixed w-[400px] h-[400px] rounded-full bg-[#18ba60]/5 blur-[120px] top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-0\" />"
TargetContent: "    <div className=\"w-[430px] bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0d1117] to-[#161b22] border border-slate-800 text-white rounded-[2.5rem] p-8 pb-10 text-center shadow-[0_25px_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)] relative overflow-hidden select-none mx-4\">\n      {/* Subtle radial glow */}\n      <div className=\"absolute w-[350px] h-[350px] rounded-full bg-[#18ba60]/5 blur-[100px] top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none z-0\" />"
